label: Bitbucket
description: Read repositories, code, and pull requests, and open issues, branches, pull requests, and comments.
securityDescription: Bitbucket sign-in opens through Composio. Agents can read the workspaces, repositories, code, commits, issues, and pull requests the connected account can reach. With write access, Agents can create branches and issues, open and edit pull requests, including their reviewers, and comment on, resolve, or reopen pull request and issue threads. Reviewers must already have access to the repository. Agents cannot create repositories, merge, approve, or decline pull requests, assign issues, push commits, delete anything, or change repository permissions or settings.

drop.BITBUCKET_CREATE_REPOSITORY: With is_private withheld, Bitbucket can create a public repository.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (starts from 1). Only applicable when browsing directories.

path.description: File or directory path within the repository to browse. Use empty string for root directory.

sort.description: Field name for sorting results. Prefix with '-' for descending order. Only applicable when browsing directories.

format.description: Response format. Use 'meta' to return metadata as JSON instead of raw file contents when browsing a file.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for breadth-first recursive directory traversal. Only applicable when path is a directory. Large values may cause timeouts.

binary.description: Whether to include binary file diffs. Set to true to include binary diffs in the output.

capabilities.description: List pull requests in which a repository commit was reviewed. Requires Bitbucket's Pull Request Commit Links app to be installed and the repository to be indexed.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Page numbering starts at 1.

commit.description: SHA1 hash of the commit whose related pull requests to list.

pagelen.description: Number of pull requests to return per page (1-100).

repo_slug.description: Repository slug or UUID containing the commit.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID that owns the repository.

input.description: Repository commit and optional page to query.

capabilities.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all public repositories on Bitbucket. Use when you need to discover or search across public repositories, optionally filtered by role, query string, creation date, or sorted by various fields.

q.description: Query string using Bitbucket Query Language (BBQL) to filter repositories. Note: This parameter requires the 'role' parameter to be specified. Syntax: 'field operator value'. Operators: '=' (exact match), '~' (contains substring), '!=' (not equal), '>' '>=' '<' '<=' (comparison for dates/numbers). String values MUST be enclosed in double quotes. Valid repository fields: 'name', 'full_name', 'is_private', 'created_on', 'updated_on', 'language'.

page.description: The page number to retrieve in the paginated list of results. Page numbering starts at 1. Use together with 'pagelen' to control pagination.

role.description: Enum for repository role filter values.

sort.description: Field to sort returned repositories by. Prefix with a hyphen (-) for descending order. Common sortable fields: 'name', 'created_on', 'updated_on'.

after.description: ISO-8601 timestamp to filter results created after this date/time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'). Only repositories created after this timestamp will be returned.

pagelen.description: The number of items to return per page. Accepts values between 1 and 100 (inclusive). Defaults to 10 if not specified.

input.description: Request model for the ListRepositories action. Specifies optional query parameters for filtering and sorting public repositories.

capabilities.description: Lists repositories in a specified Bitbucket workspace, accessible to the authenticated user, with options to filter by role or query string, and sort results. Responses are paginated; iterate using the `next` field in each response until it is absent to retrieve all repositories.

q.description: Query string using Bitbucket Query Language (BBQL) to filter repositories. Syntax: 'field operator value'. Operators: '=' (exact match), '~' (contains substring), '!=' (not equal), '>' '>=' '<' '<=' (comparison for dates/numbers). String values MUST be enclosed in double quotes. Valid repository fields: 'name', 'full_name', 'project.key', 'is_private', 'created_on', 'updated_on', 'language'. Combine multiple conditions with AND/OR (e.g., 'name~"api" AND is_private=true').

page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

role.description: Filters repositories by the authenticated user's role within each repository.

sort.description: Field for sorting repository results. Prefix with '-' for descending order. Common sortable fields: 'name', 'updated_on', 'created_on'.

pagelen.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified.

workspace.description: The identifier of the Bitbucket workspace. This can be the workspace slug (e.g., 'my-workspace') or its UUID enclosed in curly braces (e.g., '{workspace-uuid}'). Empty results may indicate insufficient permissions rather than an invalid identifier.

capabilities.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all forks for a specific repository in a Bitbucket workspace. Returns repository objects for each fork with metadata like owner, creation date, and size. Use this action when you need to discover who has forked a repository or analyze fork relationships.

page.description: The page number to retrieve in the paginated list of results. Page numbering starts at 1. Use together with 'pagelen' to control pagination.

pagelen.description: The number of items to return per page. Accepts values between 1 and 100 (inclusive).

repo_slug.description: The repository slug (URL-friendly identifier) for the repository whose forks to list.

workspace.description: The workspace slug or UUID that owns the repository.

input.description: Request model for the ListRepositoryForks action. Specifies path parameters and optional pagination parameters.

capabilities.description: Lists file and directory entries under a repository path at a given revision, with optional breadth-first recursion via max_depth for repository traversal and scanning. Fails if the path points to a file rather than a directory.

q.description: Filter query string using Bitbucket's REST API filtering syntax to narrow results.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (starts from 1).

path.description: Directory path within the repository to list. Use empty string for root. Must be a directory, not a file.

sort.description: Field name for sorting results. Prefix with '-' for descending order.

commit.description: Commit hash, branch name, or tag to list paths from. Determines the revision to traverse.

pagelen.description: Number of entries per page (1-100). Controls pagination size.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for breadth-first recursive directory traversal. If specified, includes nested subdirectories up to this depth.

repo_slug.description: Repository slug or UUID (typically URL-formatted name).

workspace.description: Workspace ID or UUID (often username or team name) containing the repository.

capabilities.description: Returns all snippets accessible to the authenticated user. Use when you need to discover or list snippets, optionally filtered by role (owner, contributor, or member).

page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

role.description: Enum for snippet role filter values.

pagelen.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Defaults to the Bitbucket API's default page length if not specified.

input.description: Request model for the ListSnippets action. Specifies optional query parameter for filtering snippets.

capabilities.description: Lists tags in a Bitbucket repository with optional server-side filtering by name pattern or commit hash (BBQL) and sorting. Use when you need to discover available tags, search for specific tag patterns, or find tags pointing to specific commits.

q.description: Query string using Bitbucket Query Language (BBQL) to filter tags. Syntax: 'field operator value'. Operators: '=' (exact match), '~' (contains substring), '!=' (not equal). String values MUST be enclosed in double quotes. Common use case: filter by tag name pattern using 'name~"pattern"' or by commit hash using 'target.hash="hash"'. Examples: 'name~"v1."' (tags starting with v1.), 'name="v1.0.0"' (exact match for v1.0.0 tag), 'target.hash="a1b2c3d4"' (tags pointing to specific commit).

page.description: Page number for paginated results (starts from 1).

sort.description: Field for sorting tag results. Prefix with '-' for descending order. Common sortable fields: 'name', 'target.date' (commit date). Default sorting applies natural sorting for tag names with numeric values.

pagelen.description: Number of tags per page (1-100). Bitbucket default is typically 10 if not specified.

repo_slug.description: The slug or UUID of the repository. This is usually the repository's name in URL-friendly format.

workspace.description: The workspace ID or slug that owns the repository. This can typically be found in the URL of your Bitbucket workspace.

input.description: Request model for listing tags in a Bitbucket repository.

capabilities.description: Lists versions (milestones) in a Bitbucket repository's issue tracker. Use when you need to discover available versions for associating with issues, or to retrieve version IDs for use with create_issue.

q.description: Query string using Bitbucket Query Language (BBQL) to filter versions. Syntax: 'field operator value'. Operators: '=' (exact match), '~' (contains substring), '!=' (not equal). String values MUST be enclosed in double quotes. Common use case: filter by version name pattern using 'name~"pattern"'. Examples: 'name~"1."' (versions starting with 1.), 'name="2.0"' (exact match for version 2.0).

page.description: Page number for paginated results (starts from 1).

sort.description: Field for sorting version results. Prefix with '-' for descending order. Common sortable fields: 'name'. Default sorting applies natural sorting.

pagelen.description: Number of versions per page (1-100). Bitbucket default is typically 10 if not specified.

repo_slug.description: The slug or UUID of the repository. This is usually the repository's name in URL-friendly format.

workspace.description: The workspace ID or slug that owns the repository. This can typically be found in the URL of your Bitbucket workspace.

input.description: Request model for listing versions in a Bitbucket repository.

capabilities.description: Lists all members of a specified Bitbucket workspace; the workspace must exist.

page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

pagelen.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Defaults to the Bitbucket API's default page length if not specified.

workspace.description: The workspace ID (UUID) or slug from which to list members. The slug is the user-friendly, URL-safe identifier for the workspace.

input.description: Request model for the BITBUCKET_LIST_WORKSPACE_MEMBERS action.

capabilities.description: Lists projects in a specified Bitbucket workspace. Use when you need to retrieve all projects belonging to a workspace.

q.description: Query string to filter projects by attributes, following Bitbucket's filtering syntax. Syntax: 'field operator value'. Operators: '=' (exact match), '~' (contains substring), '!=' (not equal). String values MUST be enclosed in double quotes. Valid project fields: 'name', 'key', 'is_private'. Combine multiple conditions with AND/OR (e.g., 'name~"api" AND is_private=true').

page.description: Specifies which page of results to return. Page numbering starts at 1.

sort.description: Field to sort returned projects by; prefix with a hyphen (-) for descending order. Common sortable fields: 'name', 'key', 'created_on', 'updated_on'.

pagelen.description: Controls the number of items per page. Must be between 1 and 100.

workspace.description: The identifier of the Bitbucket workspace. This can be the workspace slug (e.g., 'my-workspace') or its UUID enclosed in curly braces (e.g., '{workspace-uuid}').

input.description: Request model for the ListWorkspaceProjects action. Specifies the workspace and optional query parameters for filtering and sorting projects.

capabilities.description: Lists Bitbucket workspaces accessible to the authenticated user, optionally filtered and sorted. Results are paginated; follow the `next` field in each response to retrieve subsequent pages until `next` is absent. When multiple workspaces are returned, verify the correct `slug` or UUID before passing to downstream tools.

q.description: Query string to filter workspaces by attributes, following Bitbucket's filtering syntax.

page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

sort.description: Field to sort returned workspaces by; prefix with a hyphen (-) for descending order.

pagelen.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified.

input.description: Request model for the ListWorkspaces action. Specifies optional query parameters for filtering and sorting workspaces.

capabilities.description: Tool to resolve or reopen a pull request comment thread. Use when marking a comment as addressed during review or reopening a previously resolved thread.

action.description: Action to perform: 'resolve' marks the comment thread as addressed, 'reopen' unmarks it.

repo_slug.description: The repository slug (URL-friendly name).

workspace.description: The workspace slug or UUID that owns the repository.

comment_id.description: The unique identifier for the comment to resolve or reopen.

pull_request_id.description: The unique identifier of the pull request.

input.description: Request model for resolving or reopening a pull request comment thread.

capabilities.description: Tool to update an existing pull request's editable fields (e.g., title, description, reviewers) via the Bitbucket Cloud API. Use when you need to modify a pull request without creating a new one. Only sends fields that are explicitly provided to avoid accidental overwrites.

draft.description: If true, marks the pull request as a draft. If false, marks it as ready for review. If omitted, draft status remains unchanged.

title.description: Updated title for the pull request. If omitted, title remains unchanged.

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (URL-friendly name) or UUID.

uuid.description: UUID of the Bitbucket user to be a reviewer. Must be in Bitbucket's standard format with curly braces.

reviewers.description: Updated list of Bitbucket user UUIDs to be reviewers. Replaces existing reviewers. If omitted, reviewers remain unchanged.

workspace.description: Workspace ID (slug) or workspace UUID that owns the repository.

description.description: Updated Markdown description for the pull request. If omitted, description remains unchanged.

pull_request_id.description: Unique ID of the pull request to update.

close_source_branch.description: If true, automatically closes the source branch upon pull request merge. If omitted, setting remains unchanged.

input.description: Request to update an existing pull request's editable fields.
